# WorldBox Modding Docs — AI entry

Site release: 0.3.0
Main tested stack: WorldBox 0.51.2 build 719 / Unity 2022.3.60f1 / NeoModLoader 1.2.0.1. PoliticalWorldAPI evidence also names API 1.14.0 where applicable.

## Reliability contract

1. Never invent a class, method, overload, field, hook, event, save key, path or lifecycle guarantee because it sounds plausible.
2. Version labels are part of every runtime claim. Future WorldBox/NML/PW versions require re-test or a compatibility diff.
3. Canonical WBML machine export and final matrix outrank prose summaries. Detailed Docs interpret them. Quick Docs only summarize and may not widen claims.
4. `VERIFIED` = exact tested call/read success under exported proof/sample; not universal semantics.
5. `OBSERVED-THREW` = exact owner + exact argument set threw the recorded exception; not “method is broken”.
6. `VERIFIED-REVERSIBLE` applies only to the exact controlled scalar transaction exported by WBML 0.5.0.
7. `VERIFIED-LIFECYCLE` = natural lifecycle path removed the entity from pinned manager/owner/registry evidence and stale checks passed.
8. `VERIFIED-NONTERMINAL-WINDOW` and `VERIFIED-EMPTY-REGISTERED-WINDOW` are bounded windows, never permanent-persistence claims.
9. Keep access/visibility and provenance. Reflection verification does not make an internal/private member a stable public API.
10. Same CLR type is not enough for a parameter. Use semantic provenance from the canonical 0.4 atlas; unresolved arguments stay unresolved.
11. SKIP/unexecuted branches never become Verified. Failed/superseded harnesses are negative knowledge only.
12. If the docs/evidence do not answer the question, say `research-needed` and propose a focused WBML probe.

## High-value current facts

WBML 0.3: 18,625 methods scanned; 1,462 zero-arg queries VERIFIED; 1,116 public + 346 reflection; unsafe/stale invocations 0.
WBML 0.4: 315 parameterized queries VERIFIED; semantic argument provenance required; 11 exact OBSERVED-THREW records; weak arbitrary strings/IDs are rejected or unresolved.
WBML 0.5: 19/19 selected scalar transactions VERIFIED-REVERSIBLE; restoreFailed/collateral/residual all 0. The 7,049 mutation/lifecycle queue entries are NOT safe APIs.
WBML 0.6: Actor.dieSimpleNone and City.destroyCity are VERIFIED-LIFECYCLE. Building.kill remained registered in pinned manager+owner for 30 frames. A Kingdom with all five remaining cities naturally destroyed reached zero cities but remained registered for 120 frames. Both latter results are bounded negative lifecycle evidence.

## Planned WorldBox Modding API

The shared WorldBox Modding API is a future dependency mod planned after WBML 1.0. It does not exist yet. Design sketches like `WBAPI.Actors.TryResolve(...)` are not current callable API. The intended pipeline is WorldBox internals -> WBML -> docs -> shared API -> Fog of War Overhaul / Political World / third-party mods.


# Expanded retrieval notes

## WBML 0.2 structural atlas

Canonical metrics: types 2905; members 38553; type ID collisions 0; runtime concrete 697; runtime specialized 29; runtime records 676; unmapped 0; safe reads 8488/0 failures; relations 19150; unresolved endpoints 0; queue 15079; stability 4988 same / 12 changed / 0 failed. It is read-only discovery: discovered methods/properties/constructors were not auto-invoked.

## WBML 0.3 zero-arg capability

Canonical metrics: zeroArgNonVoid 4411; records 3021; IL-safe 1751; ownerResolved 1505; noOwner 246; invoked 1505; VERIFIED 1462; OBSERVED-THREW 43; public 1116; reflection 346; stability 1429 same / 33 changed / 0 failed. Initial 0.3 was rejected because dead/stale Actor samples and broad `attack` name heuristics distorted evidence.

Representative exact records: Actor.getAge()->Int32 sample 76, Actor.countTraits()->Int32 sample 5, City.countBuildings()->Int32 sample 100, Kingdom.getPopulationTotal()->Int32 sample 14468, Building.getCity()->City reference, WorldTile.Height sample 210, SaveManager.getCurrentSlot()->Int32 sample 11. Samples are observations, not constants.

## WBML 0.4 parameterized queries

Canonical metrics: parameterizedNonVoid 4291; records 1803; IL-safe 473; ownerResolved 382; argumentSets 326; unresolved 56; observedArgs 284; syntheticArgs 187; weakObservedRejected 223; collectionKeysObserved 1280; collectionElementsObserved 586; VERIFIED 315; OBSERVED-THREW 11.

Canonical examples: City.countBuildingsOfID("bonfire") -> 1 using City.buildings_dict_id dictionary key; City.getBuildingListOfType("type_bonfire") -> count=1 via City.buildings_dict_type key; City.getSubspeciesId("human") -> 2 via City._species key; ZoneCalculator.getZoneByID(0) -> TileZone reference via _zones_dict_id key; ArchitectureAsset.getBuildingID("order_docks_0") -> fishing_docks_civ_unicorn via styled_building_orders element; Actor.hasTrait(ActorTrait from Actor.traits[]) -> True.

Never resurrect rejected early argument choices such as `plate_kingdom`, `#00FFFF`, `The Old`, unrelated `textureID`, or arbitrary `unit` species strings as canonical parameter evidence.

## WBML 0.5 safe mutation

Exact VERIFIED-REVERSIBLE fields:
ActorData: money, experience, renown, kills, food_consumed, births, pollen, loot.
CityData: total_food_consumed, total_leaders, renown, total_births, total_deaths, total_kills.
KingdomData: total_kings, renown, total_births, total_deaths, total_kills.

Contract: snapshot -> one controlled mutation -> exact delta -> exact restore -> residual fields 0. Unknown mutation methods are only catalogued.

## WBML 0.6 lifecycle and rejected methodology

Canonical pinned sources: ActorManager F:units_only_alive; CityManager F:dict; KingdomManager F:dict; BuildingManager F:dict; Kingdom.cities F:cities; City.units P:units; City.buildings F:buildings.

Canonical outcomes: Building.kill -> VERIFIED-NONTERMINAL-WINDOW, still pinned manager+owner after 30 frames. Actor.dieSimpleNone -> VERIFIED-LIFECYCLE and 50/50 stale reads. City.destroyCity -> VERIFIED-LIFECYCLE and 50/50 stale reads. Destroy all remaining cities -> Kingdom city count 5->0 while Kingdom remained in manager for 120 frames -> VERIFIED-EMPTY-REGISTERED-WINDOW. Reintroduced=0, sameIdNewReference=0, engine/game exceptions=0.

Rejected history matters: fix1 direct manager destroy/remove + Dispose corrupted runtime and caused repeated NullReferenceException/game-loop failures; fix3 mislabeled a non-final city as the last city; fix4 floated collection provenance and falsely reported City reintroduction. Do not quote those as current WorldBox behavior.

## Existing PoliticalWorldAPI baseline

The site also contains earlier verified PoliticalWorldAPI persistence, world isolation, party lifecycle, event bus and actions/conditions/effects documentation. Use those dedicated pages for exact public API signatures. Do not mix their public wrapper guarantees with raw WorldBox internal members.

## Fog of War / Exploration future work

Planned model: Unknown / Discovered / Visible per kingdom; vision from residents/scouts/armies/ships/cities/allies/merchants; contact-gated diplomacy; stale last-known information; kingdom-view UI. If WorldBox ships native kingdom exploration first, research and extend the native system instead of duplicating it. Current WBML evidence does not yet prove the needed rendering/visibility/input hooks; mark those `research-needed`.
